dataset_stage_note: PR1 foundation slice: entries only; fragments and scenarios are added in PR2/PR3. The final dataset MUST reach exactly 32 scenarios per spec; this partial state is permitted only because the tracker branch is draft/no-merge and later slices complete the contract.

required_for_completion.final_contract: The validator final-form (PR4) MUST fail closed on any dataset that does not meet the exact 32-scenario, 16-pair, 16/16 balance contract. This partial foundation MUST NOT be merged to master.
required_for_completion.fragments: PR2 must add language-matched fragments for every entry and list them here.
required_for_completion.scenarios: PR3 must add exactly 32 scenarios (16 es / 16 en, 16 bilingual pairs, 16 supported / 16 abstention) and list them here.
